reynolds_definition: Re = U_s D / nu, U_s superficial velocity, D = 2R nominal cylinder diameter
drag_definition: K = nu u_fluid / a; f = L^2/((1-phi) f) with L the cell length per disc
drag_definition_full: f = cell_length^2 / ((1 - phi_actual) * nu * u_fluid / a)

protocol.common_mode: same nu and same step count inside a group; only the body force changes
protocol.forcing: first-order splitting, unit prefactor, fluid nodes only (tensorlbm first-order kick)

gate1_weak_inertia_law.statement: R - 1 = c1 Re + c2 Re^2 with c1 = 0: for a centro-symmetric array the first inertial correction is quadratic (weak-inertia theorem, Mei & Auriault 1991)

gate2_predictive_reference.reason: insufficient campaign data: need len(x) == len(y) > degree

gate3_mach_extrapolation.statement: R(Re, Ma) is quadratic in Ma: the Ma -> 0 extrapolation of the four-point sweep leaves a residual <= 1 % (fit residual <= 1e-6 absolute)

gate4_porosity_surface.statement: R(Re, phi) produced for square phi = 0.40 (primary) and hex phi = 0.55 / 0.60 (auxiliary); the Stokes drag increases monotonically with phi

gate5_stokes_limit.statement: Re -> 0 drag ratio returns to the Stokes value within 0.5 %

gate6_dilute_log_law.statement: 4 pi / f = ln(1/sqrt(phi)) + C + A phi: the coefficient of the logarithm is analytically one (2D Stokeslet), verified with the log coefficient fixed and (C, A) free, to 2 %
gate6_dilute_log_law.free_slope_note: the free-slope fit is 0.87-0.95 on a finite-phi window, which is the O(phi) shift that the constrained fit absorbs in A; a slope of one is only reached as phi -> 0

tau_independence.note: Fixed-Re viscosity ladder: the physical drag must be nu independent, so this is a purely numerical systematic of the staircase bounce-back wall position under the first-order split forcing. It cancels inside a fixed-nu group and is de-trended (not fitted away) for the Mach sweep, which is the only group that must vary nu.

uncertainty_bracket.note: The common-protocol design assumes the residual transient is common-mode and cancels in the ratio. Doubling the protocol length measures the size of the violation; it bounds the systematic error of the expansion coefficients.

secondary_literature.note: digitised literature table (Sangani & Acrivos 1982; the square-array column), quoted for orientation only. It is NOT a gate: the square entries are Stokes-limit values, so a finite-Re case sits above them by design (+c2 Re^2), and the point of this benchmark is a self-produced reference. The residual few-per-cent offset at the Stokes branch is the staircase-wall discretisation error of a d ~ 29-cell disc, decreasing with resolution (see checks.grid_consistency).
